description: Parse a .tscn file for ext_resource references (scripts, textures, subscenes). Use to see what a scene depends on before refactoring or moving files. Returns: scenePath and dependencies[], one per ext_resource reference (path, type, optional uid). warnings leads when ext_resource lines could not be read. Errors if the file does not exist or is not a text scene or resource.

projectPath.description: Path to the Godot project directory

scenePath.description: Path to the .tscn file relative to the project root (e.g. "scenes/main.tscn")

name: get_scene_dependencies
